meta.project: AddMenu - Digital Menu QR Code Platform

product_overview: AddMenu is a modern digital menu platform for restaurants enabling menu uploads, QR code generation, customer engagement through feedback and bell calling, and comprehensive analytics, backed by a subscription model.
core_goals: Provide restaurants with an easy-to-use digital menu solution replacing physical menus.
Enable restaurants to generate unique QR codes linking to their digital menus.
Facilitate customer engagement through bell calling service and feedback systems.
Provide restaurant owners with analytics on menu views and customer interactions.
Support subscription management and payment processing for monetization.
Maintain secure and scalable architecture with proper user and admin management.
key_features: Digital Menu Upload: Restaurants can upload and manage menu images with compression and ordering functionality.
QR Code Generation: Unique QR codes are generated for each restaurant for customers to scan and access menus.
Restaurant Dashboard: Owners can manage menus, profile, social links, view analytics, feedback, and bell notifications.
Bell Calling Service: Customers can request service from their tables using a bell button feature available to subscribed plans.
Customer Feedback System: Collect and display customer ratings and comments to restaurant owners.
Subscription Management: Subscription plans with payment processing via Razorpay including plan upgrades and renewals.
Analytics Tracking: Track menu views and customer engagement to provide actionable insights.
User Authentication: Secure sign-in, sign-up with payment integration, and password recovery with rate limiting.
Admin Dashboard: Admins can manage users, subscriptions, and audit logs with security and role management.
SEO Optimization: Dynamic meta tags and structured data for improved search engine ranking.
Static and Error Pages: Includes About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, and custom error pages for a polished user experience.
user_flow_summary: User visits the Home Page to learn about the product features and subscription plans.
Restaurant owner registers via the Authentication flow, including payment for subscription if applicable.
Upon successful login, restaurant owner accesses the Restaurant Dashboard to upload menus, generate QR codes, and configure profile details and social links.
Customers scan restaurant QR codes to view the digital menu on Menu View pages.
Customers use the Bell Service button to request waiter service, notifying the restaurant owner via dashboard alerts.
Customers submit feedback after using the restaurant, which is accessible to owners in the Feedback system.
Restaurant owners monitor analytics for menu views, engagement, and customer feedback through the dashboard.
Owners manage subscription plans, renewals, or upgrades using the integrated Razorpay payment system.
Admin personnel access the Admin Dashboard for managing users, subscriptions, and monitoring audit logs, including enabling or disabling accounts.
validation_criteria: Menu uploads must support image compression and prevent exceeding upload limits based on subscription plan.
QR codes generated must uniquely correspond to each restaurant and link correctly to their digital menu.
Bell Calling feature must notify restaurant owners in real-time when a customer requests service.
Customer feedback must be stored securely and displayed accurately to restaurant owners.
Subscription payments must be processed correctly through Razorpay with webhook integration handling events like activation, renewal, cancellation, and failures.
Authentication flows must enforce rate limiting, secure validation, and avoid XSS vulnerabilities.
Analytics data collection must accurately track menu views and customer engagement without data loss.
Admin actions must be logged and require proper authentication and session validation.
SEO meta tags and structured data must be correctly rendered to aid search engine indexing.
Error pages like 404 and Session Expired must display properly with user-friendly messages.
